full_details: You went to Southampton House at the hour you had set. The porter said he knew the name. My lord was at court. Master Florio was within, and teaching, and you did not see him. You left the paper for him to give or not as he judged, and you sat four minutes on the lodge bench. You were not asked further in. As you turned from the gate you told yourself it was done. In the afternoon you played Egeon in the Errors. Kemp was civil. You did not open a tally. You did not go to the Rose. After supper you struck a gloss on the new comedy's roll and left the king's first line alone. You did not write a figure in any margin.
one_sentence: You left a sealed paper at the lodge, played Egeon at the Cross Keys, and struck a gloss on the roll.
title: A paper at the lodge, and four minutes on the bench
